name: zime-skills
description: Open-source GTM skills: call prep, follow-ups, deal and account reviews, competitive intel, sales assets and CS handovers, grounded in your real calls and CRM through the Zime MCP server. Requires a Zime account.

interface.shortDescription: Sales skills on your real calls and deals
interface.longDescription: Zime records and analyzes your sales calls and links them to CRM deals, accounts and contacts. These skills use that data to prep your next call, draft follow-ups, review calls and accounts, track commitments, build battlecards and sales assets, and write CS handovers. Requires a Zime account.
defaultPrompt: Prep me for my next call
Draft the follow-up for my last call
